FN-P6K3EE-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 207
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Representative Neil Rafferty
Commissions
Analyst: JT Mathis Date: 03/28/2023
House Bill 207 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Alabama Board of Examiners
of Landscape Architects until October 1, 2027 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill
will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
